page.layout: One column of running text, notes in the right margin, and at the foot a signature at left and a catchword at right.

main_text.p: qua cum miles, centuriæ D. Gloff. in cap. Re-baptizar. de confc. crat. di. ftinct. 4.Harbord origine Scotus, cui nomen David Hankock, à mi-lite Gallo provocatus esset, etiam nominibus injuriosis ejus religionem tangentibus, quod puritanus esset, præcisista, &c. irritatus, duellum oblatum suscepit, Gallum semel atque iterum in terram prostravit, & tertium cum illo concurrens ad necem usque vulneravit. Causâ ad consilium militare delatâ, veniam delicti impetravit, quod religionis quam profitebatur, gratiâ duellum, sibi oblatum, invisset.

Simile exemplum refert Zyp. Pont. Nov. Annal. Enarrat. libr. 5. tit. de Pugnanc. in duell.Zypæus, de Nobili quopiam, Belgicas ditiones regente Maria Hungariæ. Is, inquit, in rixâ, ob religionem motâ, hæreticum quendam (sic loquitur), gravi pugno occiderat, & pro abolitione criminis,

page.notes: The right-margin notes are read from a small, cramped print; "Gloff. in cap. Re-baptizar. de confc. crat. di. ftinct. 4." and the Zypæus references ("Annal. Enarrat. libr. 5. tit. de Pugnanc.") are doubtful in their abbreviations, and I have transcribed them as printed as far as I can see them. "præcisista" is read with its long s as printed. The word at the foot "re-" is the catchword and "N" the signature. No other marks are visible on the page; the faint text in the lower right corner is a digitiser's watermark and is left out.
